Priyom —

Thanks for the context. Draft language below that legal can accept and that addresses NovaPromo's needs: feel free to paste into the MSA redline. I added bracketed options where appropriate.

Proposed publicity clause (short form):
"Company may issue press releases and marketing materials referencing Customer's name or logo provided that (i) Company provides Customer with a textual preview of the proposed release at least five (5) business days prior to publication; (ii) Customer's review is limited to non-binding comments and may not unreasonably withhold approval; (iii) Company may make minor grammatical edits to Customer-supplied short quotes (not exceeding sixty (60) words) without further approval; and (iv) Customer consents to attribution in the form 'Quote — Customer Name' unless otherwise specified in writing. Customer grants Company a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use such short quotes in marketing materials for twelve (12) months following publication."

Notes:
- "Non-binding comments" language avoids a veto right while giving them the preview they want.
- Define short quote as <= 60 words to keep marketing flexibility.
- For logotype usage, include a separate reference to brand guidelines and requirement for a provided vector asset; that should live in the SOW if NovaPromo wants limited logo placement.

Ben: if marketing is comfortable with the 60-word definition and the 12-month royalty-free window, I'll incorporate this into the MSA redline. If you want a different attribution format, call it out now.

Olga: one evidence ask — Contracts may request confirmation that NovaPromo has an internal contact (name + email) to approve previews; if they don't provide a designated reviewer, Contracts may default approval to the Contracts contact after the 5-day window lapses. Should we include that fallback?

Rachel

Eric —

Per legal review, please see proposed MSA text pasted below. If that's acceptable, Contracts will add it as Section 7.2 and we can move to signature. A few operational notes included.

[Proposed MSA publicity clause]
Company may issue press releases and marketing materials referencing Customer's name, logo, or short quote provided that (i) Company provides Customer with a textual preview at least five (5) business days prior to publication; (ii) Customer's review is limited to non-binding comments and shall not unreasonably withhold approval; (iii) Company may make minor, non-substantive edits for grammar or formatting to Customer-supplied short quotes not exceeding sixty (60) words without additional approval; (iv) Attribution shall be in the form 'Quote — Customer Name' unless Customer specifies otherwise in writing; and (v) Customer grants Company a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use such short quotes for twelve (12) months following the date of first publication.

Operational items:
- Please provide a named reviewer (name + title + email) for preview notices. If no reviewer is provided, Contracts may deem the Contracts contact (contracts@novapromo.com) the approver and proceed after the 5-day window.
- If logo files are required, please supply a vector PNG/SVG and brand guidelines for placement. Logo use beyond the Order Form will require a separate approval.

If that looks good, can Contracts prepare a DocuSign with the MSA + Order Form? I've attached the SOW v3 for reference.

Thanks,
